evidence.excerpt: Nikola Stojanović is an Associate Professor in the Department of Computing and Control Engineering at the Faculty of Technical Sciences, University of Novi Sad. His research focuses on computer vision, machine learning, and edge computing, with particular emphasis on defect detection, anomaly detection, and industrial visual inspection. He has pioneered work on few-shot learning methods adapted for constrained manufacturing environments, as well as model quantization techniques that enable real-time inference on resource-limited edge devices. Before returning to academia full-time, Stojanović co-founded a computer vision consultancy (2016–2019), gaining hands-on industry experience in automated inspection systems. He currently leads academic activities within the VISIONQC project and supervises graduate and doctoral students in applied AI for industrial quality control.
